_note: The Deno half of the scheduler pin. Deno resolves the bare `fyflow-scheduler` specifier to JSR's @fyflow/scheduler at the SAME version package.json pins for npm; `scripts/check-scheduler.mjs` D3 is what compares the two. Both registries carry 0.5.2 as of 2026-09-08 (0.5.1 from 2026-09-07, 0.3.0 from 2026-08-31 before that) - which is what made ADR 0013's working-tree link unnecessary. Since ADR 0048 (W57) deno.json carries the SAME mapping, because the published source imports the scheduler and a JSR package declares a dependency exactly there; this file stays as the map the L6 scripts pass with --import-map, so the rung reads its pin from the file D3 and D6 have always bound, and D8 holds deno.json's copy to the same pin. (This note read 'Deliberately NOT in deno.json ... this library depends on the scheduler at runtime not at all (ADR 0013 rule 1)' from ADR 0029 until W57 superseded that rule.)
